Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. With rational opponents, the dominant strategy is truthful bidding: bid your exact value. Underbidding risks losing profitable wins; overbidding risks winning at a price exceeding value. No history to leverage and only one round. Therefore, bid exactly my value: 6.

In a second-price auction with independent private values, the dominant strategy is truthful bidding. My value is 0, so bidding anything above 0 risks winning and paying a positive second-highest price, yielding negative profit. Bidding exactly 0 ensures I never incur a loss and only (rarely) win at price 0, giving zero payoff. Optimal long-run and this round: bid 0.
